name: The Fae King Is My Roommate
source:
Your peaceful life as a hermit is rudely interrupted when a ‘delicate young man’ gets himself caught in a mutated Venus flytrap.

Will you save him, or let him be eaten? That is, if he even needs saving in the first place.

[From [url=https://chthonicchromestudio.itch.io/the-fae-king-is-my-roommate]itch.io[/url]]
